name: Shoujo Rensa 2 ~Doutei Shounen. Kairaku Choukyou Seme~
original_name: 少女連鎖2～童貞少年・快楽調教責め～
source:
Main character's training is finished, and he becomes part of this mansion. So mansion owner Mayura invites protagonist's tutor to the mansion, and another round of M training begins by the unusual mansion staff.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的修行结束，成为这座宅邸的一部分。于是，宅邸主人真由邀请了主角的导师来到宅邸，不寻常的宅邸工作人员又开始了新一轮的M训练。
